name: Dead Stock
source:
Welcome, lost soul, to an infinite land of non-stop shopping experiences! Get a brand new look at Buck-It! Try your luck at One More Pull! Feeling peckish? Have a snack at Pretty Pretz! And take home a memory for your friends (or just yourself) at SSSupernirs! 

Oh yeah, sure, you may not have a home anymore, but who needs one when you have these deals! Join our fun and loving corporate family as we work together to supply all the stock for our wonderous stores!

Now accepting (mandatory) applications if you have recently died.
You're sure to be fulfilled!

[From [url=https://no-xiruo.itch.io/dead-stock]itch.io[/url]]
